items.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
items.description: Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war.

items.title: Twelve killed in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
items.description: Another 309 people are injured in the attack on the airport, which come days after Yemen's Houthis said they had struck it.

items.title: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
items.description: A desperate junta is in a war of attrition against ethnic militias and and civilian resistance.

items.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people
items.description: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

items.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
items.description: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.

items.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
items.description: Roofs were ripped off buildings after Isaias barrelled into the US on Friday evening, before it weakened to a post-tropical cyclone.

items.title: Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
items.description: The team en route to the suspected crash site aim finally to solve the mystery of her 1937 disappearance.

items.title: Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students
items.description: Former students launched their own investigation, spending years collecting evidence and testimonies from others who say they were abused by the headteacher.

items.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
items.description: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.

items.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
items.description: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".

items.title: 'Cockroach' group leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi protest
items.description: The group - who are not registered as a political party in India - want electoral reforms ahead of crucial state elections.

items.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
items.description: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

claude-code.name: colab-qwen
claude-code.description: Claude Code skill: on-demand Qwen worker on a Google Colab A100 via Ollama, started per task and stopped right after

claude-code.name: agent-afk
claude-code.description: The coding agent you don’t have to watch. Start a task and walk away. AFK builds the feature, verifies its own work, and texts you when it’s done. You come back to a receipt of every step, every decision, and what’s waiting on you. If it’s unsure, it stops and asks instead of guessing.

claude-code.name: Rapid-MLX
claude-code.description: Rapid-MLX is an open-source (Apache 2.0) OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM inference server for Apple Silicon, built on MLX, focused on reliable tool calling for coding agents. Up to 4× faster than Apple's MLX (mlx-lm) on the same weights.

claude-code.name: sbxm
claude-code.description: Rust CLI that creates per-project Docker Sandboxes (sbx) for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Pi from one shared, versioned config, with deny-by-default egress, config drift detection and one-command rebuilds.

claude-code.name: CodeyBox
claude-code.description: Runs CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, opencode) against a task queue. Each works in an isolated VM; output is checked by configurable auditors, then merged via git. Pools multiple provider subscriptions with quota-aware routing and fallback. C#/.NET 10, MIT-licensed.
